Optimize my repository with search evidence
Upload and verify my GitHub social preview image

legends-obs-kit.purpose: Inspect, configure, and verify OBS Studio recording workflows, plus an optional cursor overlay extra.

Dictate into another application

legends-empire.purpose: Markdown knowledge foundation. For vault cleanup and project or session review, invoke the named vault stewardship capability (legends-vault-stewardship), included in the same Empire installation. Agents name the selected workflow before checking readiness and performing work. Optional Home-ready shared-root structure supports standalone Empire projects and an independently authorized AI Marketing Hub Home headless capability layer without duplicate business records.
legends-empire.scope: Python 3.11+ standard-library core. Reviewed transactions and knowledge attachment support native Windows on local fixed NTFS, plus macOS/Linux/POSIX. Windows fails closed on reparse paths, network shares and non-NTFS volumes. Windows process-crash recovery does not claim POSIX directory-fsync power-loss equivalence. Bash utilities remain POSIX-only; WSL DrvFS needs metadata. Obsidian Desktop is optional.

examples: Save this research in my vault
Find what we already know about this business
Clean and organize my vault with vault stewardship
Invoke legends-vault-stewardship
Review neglected projects and their next actions
Help me resume unfinished work from session handoffs
Attach the stewardship knowledge library to my Empire
Verify saved research evidence and plan its intake into this client vault
Slot my authorized AI Marketing Hub Home workspace into Empire
Check Home adapter compatibility without moving business records
Prepare a Home-ready Empire without installing Home
Add my authorized Home capability layer to the shared Empire root
discovery.not_for: Inventing sources, treating orphaned notes as disposable, controlling live agent sessions, or modifying a vault without selecting it. Native Windows transactions do not support network/UNC shares, reparse paths or non-NTFS volumes, and do not promise POSIX-equivalent power-loss durability. Bash utilities require POSIX. Does not grant private Home repository access, redistribute Home, activate Obsidian plugins, or automatically migrate business records.
discovery.setup: Select a vault. For vault stewardship, follow the installed recipe and run cto-legends run legends-vault-stewardship -- steward doctor. Research-export readiness applies only to research-export tasks. Native Windows transactions and knowledge attachment require Empire 0.3.1+, Python 3.11+, local fixed NTFS and supported current-user ACL ownership/security state; readiness fails closed for unsupported paths or security conditions. Review and apply in the same environment. macOS/Linux use POSIX filesystem semantics; WSL DrvFS needs metadata. Bash utilities remain POSIX-only. For optional Home-ready shared-root work, read docs/home-adapter.md. Preparation and original scaffolds work without Home. Adding the headless capability layer requires independently authorized pinned local Home source and explicit reviewed install, compose, and shared-root binding plans. Native Home validation has separate interpreter/dependency requirements. Home is not required for ordinary Empire installation, doctor, or vault workflows.

legends-grant.purpose: Discover US grants, collect evidence, review eligibility and draft evidence-linked grant proposals for businesses, nonprofits, tribes, governments, researchers and individuals.
legends-grant.scope: Nationwide source planning, bounded Grants.gov and four third-party state feeds, local evidence search, public notice collection and integrity verification. Qualification requires manually reviewed rules and separate private facts. Proposal scaffolding, mechanical checks and rendering support agent-written drafts; claim support requires substantive review. Directory routes are not completed searches; no automated submissions.

examples: Find US grants for a small business or nonprofit
Find state and local grants for a tribe or government
Research funding opportunities for researchers and individuals
Find employer training subsidies and workforce reimbursement
Collect grant notices and review eligibility evidence
Write a grant proposal from the funder questions and applicant facts
Review grant narrative, budget and required attachments
discovery.not_for: Guaranteed eligibility or awards, exhaustive nationwide coverage, automatic rule extraction, automatically complete notice inventories, historical awards presented as open grants, automatic submissions or paid database access. Mechanical checks proving factual support or predicting awards.
discovery.setup: Python 3.11+. Run offline doctor, then inspect task-specific source and evidence readiness. Core runtime has no third-party dependencies or API keys; PDF text extraction uses the optional pdf extra. Keep applicant facts and assessments outside public evidence and the managed installation. Source planning covers US jurisdictions; live feeds cover only declared sources.

legends-firecrawl.purpose: Official Firecrawl web operations and Alexandria queries with complete saved evidence, offline retrieval, integrity verification and explicit reuse checks.
legends-firecrawl.scope: Official Firecrawl execution only. Full captures live outside installations by default, with portable evidence export, verification, inventory, focused views and reuse checks. No native bypasses or savings claims. Python web client and Node Alexandria launcher; live calls need setup and authorization. Alexandria queries require --confirm.

examples: Scrape this page to markdown
Search the web for competitors
Find and inspect saved Firecrawl evidence without another API call
discovery.not_for: Direct-source bypasses, credit-saving substitutions, proprietary data or intelligence beyond Firecrawl, authentication or access-control bypass.
discovery.setup: Live calls require FIRECRAWL_API_KEY. Web workflows require firecrawl-cli 1.23.3; Alexandria requires Node.js. Catalog browsing is offline. Paid Alexandria requests require --confirm.

legends-yt-dlp.purpose: Repeatable yt-dlp source pulls, verification, transcripts, search, and clip-building with pacing and bulk guardrails.
legends-yt-dlp.scope: Pip-installed Python CLI in an isolated env. Needs local yt-dlp binary plus ffmpeg for media work. Ordinary downloads need no VPN; agents offer optional VPN help conversationally for large batches and handle the commands.

examples: Rip this video for my edit
Archive this channel with pacing
discovery.not_for: Bypassing DRM, paywalls, logins, captchas, or access controls; rotating relays to push through throttles or blocks.
discovery.setup: Managed yt-dlp binary via legends-yt-dlp yt-dlp install; ffmpeg on PATH for clips; CrispASR external for transcription.

legends-ambient-intelligence.purpose: Passive ambient audio capture, deduplicated archiving, offline transcription, and vault distillation.
legends-ambient-intelligence.scope: Pip-installed Python CLI in an isolated env. Needs ffmpeg plus faster-whisper or NeMo for transcription; USB recorder ingest is Windows-first.

examples: Transcribe my voice memos offline
Ingest recordings from my KT5000

Fix these captions and prove the render

legends-hetzner.purpose: Inspect Hetzner Cloud projects, prepare reviewed server plans, and attach a source-cited operations library to a selected Empire vault.
legends-hetzner.scope: Python 3.10+ standard-library workflows over the official hcloud CLI. Read-only readiness, inventory, catalog and preflight; reviewed server plans and explicit creation. A bounded Windows-client live canary validated Ubuntu 24.04 server creation/readback, SSH, cloud-init and cleanup. Optional versioned knowledge attachment uses Empire 0.3.1+ separately, including native Windows local fixed NTFS with Python 3.11+.

examples: Help me manage my Hetzner Cloud servers
Check my Hetzner project and plan a new server
Set up Hetzner with my agent
Attach the Hetzner operations knowledge library to my Empire
discovery.not_for: Hetzner Robot bare metal, automatic app migration, full infrastructure reconciliation, billing management, or guaranteed SSH/application health. The live canary does not validate every client OS, image or location, application health, or backup restores. Native Windows knowledge attachment excludes reparse paths, network shares and non-NTFS volumes; Windows process-crash recovery is not POSIX directory-fsync power-loss equivalence.
discovery.setup: Install the official hcloud CLI separately. Run offline doctor, then use an explicitly selected hcloud context or HCLOUD_TOKEN for live reads. Server creation requires the reviewed plan hash and explicit approval; follow docs/LIVE-CANARY.md for bounded lifecycle validation and identity-checked cleanup. Empire is optional. Native Windows knowledge attachment requires Empire 0.3.1+, Python 3.11+, local fixed NTFS and supported current-user ACL state; unsupported paths or security conditions fail closed. macOS/Linux or configured WSL use POSIX permissions. Preview and apply in the same environment. No vault writes or cloud purchases during module installation.
